Topic: Headache
Aliases: head ache, migraine, head pain, pounding head
Keywords: tension, throbbing, temples
Description: A headache is a pain in any region of the head. It can occur on one or both sides of the head.
Symptoms: Pain in the head, Sensitivity to light, Nausea
Guidance: Rest in a quiet, dark room, Stay hydrated, Try relaxation techniques
Seek Help: If it is severe, sudden, or accompanied by fever, stiff neck, or confusion.

Topic: Brain Fog
Aliases: confusion, mental fatigue, cloudy head, can't focus, dizziness
Keywords: concentration, focus, memory
Description: Brain fog isn't a medical condition itself, but a symptom of other conditions. It involves memory problems, lack of mental clarity, and inability to focus.
Symptoms: Trouble concentrating, Forgetfulness, Mental fatigue, Cloudy thinking
Guidance: Ensure you get 7-8 hours of sleep, Stay hydrated, Take breaks during work, Manage stress levels
Seek Help: If symptoms persist for a long time and affect daily life.

Topic: Chickenpox
Aliases: varicella, chicken pox, itchy bumps
Keywords: blisters, rash, spots, itch
Description: An infection caused by the varicella-zoster virus. It causes an itchy rash with small, fluid-filled blisters.
Symptoms: Itchy rash, Blisters, Fever, Tiredness and generally feeling unwell
Guidance: Do not scratch the blisters, Apply calamine lotion, Take cool baths with baking soda or oatmeal
Seek Help: If the rash spreads to the eyes, or if it becomes very red, warm, or tender (indicating a secondary infection).

Topic: Influenza (Flu)
Aliases: the flu, influenza, bad cold, fever and chills
Keywords: respiratory, virus, chills, sweats
Description: A viral infection that attacks your respiratory system — your nose, throat and lungs.
Symptoms: Fever, Aching muscles, Chills and sweats, Headache, Dry, persistent cough
Guidance: Rest and sleep, Drink plenty of liquids, Stay warm
Seek Help: If you are at high risk of complications or if symptoms are severe and not improving.

Topic: Sleep Problems
Aliases: insomnia, can't sleep, trouble sleeping, waking up, sleep apnea
Keywords: tired, fatigue, awake, restless
Description: Conditions that affect sleep quality, timing, or duration and impact a person's ability to properly function while they are awake.
Symptoms: Difficulty falling asleep, Waking up often during the night, Waking up too early, Daytime sleepiness
Guidance: Maintain a regular sleep schedule, Create a restful environment, Limit screen time before bed, Avoid caffeine late in the day
Seek Help: If sleep problems last more than a few weeks or affect your daily life.

Topic: Healthy Lifestyle
Aliases: diet, exercise, nutrition, wellness, fitness
Keywords: healthy, active, food, lifestyle
Description: A healthy lifestyle includes balanced nutrition, regular physical activity, adequate rest, and good mental health practices.
Symptoms: 
Guidance: Eat a variety of foods including plenty of fruits and vegetables, Exercise regularly (aim for 150 minutes a week), Drink plenty of water, Manage stress
Seek Help: Consult a doctor before starting any rigorous new exercise or diet program, especially if you have existing health conditions.

Topic: Dehydration
Aliases: dehydrated, lack of water, not drinking enough, thirst
Keywords: water, fluid, hydration, dry
Description: Dehydration occurs when you use or lose more fluid than you take in, and your body doesn't have enough water and other fluids to carry out its normal functions.
Symptoms: Extreme thirst, Less frequent urination, Dark-colored urine, Fatigue, Dizziness, Confusion
Guidance: Drink plenty of water, Drink oral rehydration solutions, Avoid caffeine and alcohol, Rest in a cool area
Seek Help: If you have had diarrhea for 24 hours, are irritable or disoriented, can't keep fluids down, or have bloody or black stool.
